T2P-1.repair: At disposal the COMPLETE failed receipt + accounting + late obligations (+ D2 CREATED record) snapshot is frozen as canonical JSON text bound by SHA-256 (RAM, feeder and D2 sink alike); every snapshot recomputes it byte-identically; RAM frozen state may deviate from clean ONLY in fifo_same_inode_still_fifo=False/sink_settled=False (errors==[], reader/unblock close errors None, unblock_fd_closed True, observed reader identity == original FIFO, no finish_error...) with independent present evidence (moved original FIFO, replacement present, reader number not naming the original FIFO); licensed fault evidence SHA-bound. An inventory entry is filtered only if it has only known keys and state/late_obligations byte-identical to the frozen snapshot; same-object extra/contradictory faults stay unresolved. Counterexamples: receipt errors with null aggregate, unblock not closed, wrong observed FIFO, finish error, missing evidence, later same-object fault, contradictory/extended entries, D2 contradictory same-object entry, feeder contradictory entry.

T2P-3.repair: Original end fenced after successful open, after each successful write and after a successful close; every late observation appended to result['late'] and ok refused; closure evidence preserved (closed True even when late); a failed close stays close_error/closed False and is never retried; ok is computed only after the single close.
